assertions.statement: The Maven reactor compiles and tests with yudao-module-rental-api and yudao-module-rental-biz enabled.
Additive migrations create the approved rental schema with required uniqueness, indexes, audit, tenant, and retention behavior.
Customer Web and uni-app return the same backend-authoritative catalog, quote, availability, order, payment, and deposit results.
Concurrent order or assignment attempts cannot create duplicate orders or overlapping effective schedules.
Admin users can manage products, packages, devices, orders, schedules, fulfillment, inspection, maintenance, finance, channels, and reports under explicit permissions.
Staff scan flows validate physical-device identity and lifecycle on the backend and remain idempotent under replay.
Return inspection and maintenance correctly block and release device availability while preserving history.
Rent, deposit, fees, discounts, refunds, forfeits, overdue charges, and compensation remain separately traceable and conserve integer-cent totals.
Payment and refund callbacks are verified and idempotent and cannot apply a financial transition twice.
Reports reconcile to source orders, devices, schedules, maintenance, and finance records and preserve paid review-required Xianyu revenue.
XianGuanJia configuration is disabled by default and no default test calls a real shop or exposes a credential.
The XianGuanJia signer hashes and sends the exact same canonical UTF-8 JSON body for all in-scope read endpoints.
XianGuanJia sync is bounded, cursor-safe, replay-safe, traceable, and exposes no third-party write operation.
All admin and app API contracts use typed VOs, server validation, safe errors, permissions, and actor-appropriate data masking.
Admin, customer uni-app, staff uni-app, and Nuxt Web pass their approved type, build, target, SSR, and cross-contract checks.
Visual acceptance covers all approved themes, locales, responsive layouts, and loading, empty, permission, validation, conflict, and error states.
Secret and PII scans find no real credential, signature, unrestricted raw payload, or unmasked restricted customer data.
